title: Vib2ECG: A Co-Located Chest-Lead SCG-ECG Dataset and Benchmark for ECG Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2603.15539v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Twelve-lead electrocardiography (ECG) is essential for cardiovascular diagnosis, but its long-term acquisition in daily life is constrained by complex and costly hardware. Recent efforts have explored reconstructing ECG from low-cost cardiac vibrational signals such as seismocardiography (SCG), with prior studies primarily focusing on limb leads, while clinical diagnosis requires multi-lead ECG, including chest leads. In this work, we propose Vib2ECG, a dataset of synchronized, co-located ECG and chest-wall vibration recordings, which includes complete twelve-lead ECGs and vibrational signals acquired by inertial measurement units (IMUs) at the six standard precordial electrode sites (V1-V6) from 17 subjects. Based on this dataset, we also provide a benchmark. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of reconstructing electrical cardiac signals at variable locations from vibrational signals using a lightweight 364K-parameter

translated_title: Vib2ECG：用于心电图重建的共置胸部导联SCG-ECG数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 十二导联心电图对心血管诊断至关重要，但其在日常生活中的长期采集受到复杂且昂贵硬件的限制。近期的研究探索了从低成本的心脏振动信号（如心震图SCG）重建心电图，但先前的研究主要集中于肢体导联，而临床诊断需要包括胸导联在内的多导联心电图。在这项工作中，我们提出了Vib2ECG，一个同步、共置的心电图与胸壁振动记录数据集，其中包含来自17名受试者的完整十二导联心电图以及在六个标准心前区电极位置（V1-V6）由惯性测量单元（IMU）采集的振动信号。基于该数据集，我们还提供了一个基准。实验结果证明了使用轻量级364K参数模型从振动信号重建不同位置心电信号的可行性。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个同步采集完整十二导联心电图与六个心前区位置IMU振动信号的共置数据集Vib2ECG，并建立了使用轻量级模型从振动信号重建胸部导联心电图的基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Vib2ECG, the first co-located dataset with synchronized twelve-lead ECG and IMU vibration recordings at six precordial electrode sites from 17 subjects, and establishes a benchmark for reconstructing chest-lead ECGs from vibrational signals using a lightweight 364K-parameter model.
